rationale: IND@POR (BDL 24968) appears in the BDL UTC-date response for 2026-08-01 because tip_utc=2026-08-01T02:00:00Z, but tip America/New_York=2026-07-31T22:00:00-04:00, so it belongs to the 2026-07-31 Eastern slate. Production must filter BDL games by tip date in America/New_York, not by UTC calendar date alone.
